name: Overhead
summary: A live 3D globe of everything tracked in orbit, each object where it really is right now.
description: Overhead shows around 32,000 satellites, rocket bodies and pieces of debris moving where they really are. You can scrub a week either way, pick out groups like Starlink or the space stations, ride along with the ISS and see what passes over you tonight. I built it because the trackers I used were either beautiful or useful, rarely both, and few worked on a phone. A Cloudflare Worker collects fresh orbits every two hours; everything else runs on your device, with SGP4 in a web worker and the GPU moving every object each frame.

image.alt: Overhead: a faceted globe ringed by thousands of satellites, with live counts of working satellites, rocket bodies and debris, and a timeline.
